question: What consequence of death by aging follows from daily non-eating?
premises: This practice affects the course of life
The outcome is death associated with age
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will go to death by aging
uncertainties: The intended sense of vayo-mṛtyuṃ as natural death or death of age is interpretive
plain_english: By not eating for a day, one will go to death by aging.
